WY-G.read: Culture and our call agree on the winner but not the size. Our call is Eric Barlow at R+37.7; Qloo-only is R+31.6, a 6.1-point gap, with a +3.2 statewide undertow. Wyoming loves The Ben Shapiro Show more than the nation and also puts Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Bernie Sanders on the loves-more list; it loves less Beyoncé, Whole Foods Market, Duck Dynasty, Kendrick Lamar and MSNBC. Track record: flagged counties moved the flagged way 40% from 2020 to 2024.
